# Retention and technical disposition

All 10 source entries, 64 questions, document headings, authored leads, summaries and two long supplements were read. Preflight entries are byte-equivalent under canonical insertion-order JSON to catalog-selected live entries. retention-map.json records every string/block, including all question variants; source-span-map.json gives exact changed spans. Only exact ordinary lead duplicates and duplicate unanchored JVM headings are removed. No question, href, image, anchor, metadata identity or unique technical branch is deleted.

- Execution: execute/submit exception visibility; shutdownNow wrapped handles; cleanup versus cancellation; total budgets; allOf/anyOf empty inputs; ordered/completion collection; lambda capture/batching; five-plus-six workflow; shared timeout ownership; Guava delegation/cancellation/direct executor; fork/join units; Java21/24 virtual-thread boundaries; admission 4/downstream 2; same-pool/permit deadlocks retained. Sixth stage now explicitly non-inline Async, including already-complete inputs and rejection.
- Synchronizers: object identity, static/instance locks, HotSpot21 legacy/lightweight inflation, monitor deflation; AQS owner/state/Condition; latch versus successful result; barriers/Phaser/Exchanger; N=0/1/2/17/1000 semaphore handoff; mutex-only and condition-variable RW variants; downgrade versus upgrade; StampedLock validation; ABA/stamp/markable; field updater; LongAdder snapshot, padding, VarHandle ownership retained.
- Native supplement: C++ exception-safe move constraints and shard structure; Go1.21 Cond cancellation, GMP/g0/m0, shared map/atomic/singleflight, TTL LRU; JavaScript 100 tasks/5 concurrency, microtasks versus timer yield, dependency layers and ES6 Map; Java/Go/CPython version comparison retained as design contracts.
- Systems: task generations and pause ACK; byte ownership 10=7+3; upload units 1GB/1GiB and 8MiB; rule/model UNKNOWN policy; full baseline scan, W0/H, commit ancestry, force-push, tombstones/incarnation and recovery; unknown financial outcomes; per-user sliding minute; exact executor defaults and MDC scope retained. Build/configuration facts stay distinct from deployment and performance.
- JVM guide: full route and all guide anchors retained; only duplicate title/heading presentation removed.
- Kafka: offset gaps 40/42/47→50, completion prefix, leader epoch versus assignment epoch, empty polls, revoke/lost, classic/cooperative/new consumer protocol, by_duration and reset limits retained. Supplement preserves every capacity, time, count, RF/minISR, identity, raw-byte/DLT and unknown-result condition as a verification contract rather than shipped runnable code.
- Database model/types/query material: LSM/read/write/space amplification, HBase prefix successor and hotspot counterexample, PostgreSQL visibility/HOT, vendor-specific deployment distinctions, analysis versus OLTP, document and browser persistence retained. Eight schema questions retain every cardinality and temporal variant. Ten SQL questions retain NULL, collation, duplicate multiplicity, join multiplication, counts versus rows, authorization and snapshot boundaries. Top-10 row ties versus ten distinct scores corrected without merging the two variants. No-key signed multiset table diff retained and summary corrected. All five type questions retain limits, JSON/path null distinctions, timestamp/DST, raw bytes and large-text storage. Transcript/video integrity now compares each hash to its own bytes and verifies lineage.
